notes.title: Dubai Chocolate Simulator – Coming August 7!
notes.content: [p]🍫 Dubai Chocolate Simulator launches on August 7![/p][p]In this chaotic and fun simulator, you’ll complete missions to collect rare chocolate ingredients and make the dubai chocolate in the heart of Dubai![/p][p]🎯 Complete tasks and challenges[/p][p]📅 Available on Steam starting August 7![/p][p]🛒 Don’t forget to Add to Wishlist to get notified instantly![/p][p]💬 Join our Community Hub to share your ideas, feedback, and favorite chocolate flavors.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45690207/2bb071dc43a45277952035bb871af2876a3f7ee6.png"][/img][/p]
